label: verify-t3-lumen-alt

claims.claim: Vasquez 2021: MDCK lumen shape reflects cell geometry tied to polarity, with a model that nests pressure; pressure-dominated lumen is the competing view.
claims.source_says: lumen shape reflects basic geometrical considerations tied to the establishment of apico-basal polarity. A physical model incorporating both cell geometry and intraluminal pressure can account for our observations as well as cases in which pressure plays a dominant role.
claims.note: Abstract matches; pressure is framed as the proposed alternative driver.

claims.claim: Strongest published rival is the Mukenhirn 2024 pressure versus junctional-tension force balance in MDCK-II cysts, which also reports excess apical area aiding lumen opening.
claims.source_says: Combining quantitative measurements of hydrostatic lumen pressure and junctional tension with modeling enabled us to explain lumen morphologies from the pressure-tension force balance. ... our results suggest that excess apical area contributes to lumen opening.
claims.note: Content is right (apical area is only 'suggested'), but 'strongest published rival' is the agent's judgment, not in the source.

claims.claim: Notochord ships 21.23 GB of images (6 Zenodo files) plus unlicensed MATLAB code, so it cannot be a bounded-cost companion.
claims.source_says: Zenodo 15005334: 6 files, sizes sum to 21,226,936,940 bytes, license cc-by-4.0. GitHub Physics_tube: license null, language Mathematica.
claims.note: Size, file count and missing GitHub licence reproduce; 'cannot be a bounded-cost companion' is a judgment, and the repo's main language is listed as Mathematica.

claims.claim: Law set 1.8.1 has no cell-geometry or lumen law besides accepted physiology-laplace.
claims.source_says: lawset-1.8.1.json lists 59 laws; none named for cells, lumens or epithelium. physiology-laplace status accepted; perturb-pressure is candidate. laws/ directory has 62 files.
claims.note: Law ids contain no cell-geometry or lumen entries; judged by id names only, I did not read each law body.

overall: Three of four key claims reproduce against the sources; one is partly supported because 'strongest rival' is a judgment. No fetch failures, and nothing touched the holdout.
